ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio between low-intensity (black/dark-grey) central pixels and high-intensity (white/off-white) lateral pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity regions at the distal tips of both lobes. Central areas are predominantly low-intensity with vertical medium-intensity striae extending from the notch area. Left tip high-intensity region covers approximately 15% of the lobe width; right tip high-intensity region is more mottled and fragmented.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated obtuse angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 1/10th the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth pattern with peak amplitudes ranging from 5 to 25 pixels; serration density is highest on the distal thirds of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-intensity pixel clusters (approx. 4-5 units) visible on the right lobe's ventral surface and scattered single units on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel high-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the distal half of the left lobe; singular vertical linear marks present on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the left lobe and circular scarring consistent with prior sessile organism attachment across both lobe surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'shredded' pixel geometry at the extreme lateral tips, exhibiting deeper irregular indentations compared to the medial trailing edge serrations.
